item.title: #433 How Michael Bloomberg Works
item.description:
why this sharpens your taste: 1) Senra’s craft: compress an operator’s whole work system into transferable heuristics — Bloomberg as attention architecture, not just a product story. 2) Trains you to study HOW someone works (calendar, information diet, decision hygiene) instead of only what they built.
Apple Podcasts: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/433-how-michael-bloomberg-works/id1141877104?i=1000789605191
